reason: The tenant reported no hot water on 6 May (event-001). On 13 May they said it was still not fixed (event-017). The landlord said on 15 May, from a text from his plumber, that the plumber fixed it on 14 May (event-018). That is a second-hand claim with no report, invoice or description of the checks, so it is not proof. Our voicemail and email asking the tenant to confirm (events 019, 020) are unanswered after 1.3 days. The tenant is the only party who can confirm the outcome, so I am asking for confirmation, plus details of the letterbox fault. A call was blocked because only one written message has gone unanswered. Escalation is not needed: no danger is reported, the landlord and tenant accounts differ only because we lack confirmation, and the tenant is reachable. One caveat on priority: the household has a non-English speaker and birds, and there is no hot water in May. These facts are not verified as a safety risk, so P2 applies rather than P1. Closing is not possible. The tenant has not confirmed the fix, a letterbox query is unanswered, and the invoice position and the plumber's work are unknown. If the tenant says it is still broken, I will go back to the landlord and offer an agency contractor. If there is no reply in 24 hours, I will place a call.
message: Dear Iris, the landlord has told us his plumber attended on 14 May and fixed the hot water. We have not seen any report from the plumber, and we want to hear from you before treating this as done. Please reply to confirm: (1) Is the boiler powered on and is hot water working at the taps and shower now? (2) Did anyone attend the property, and if so, when? If there is still no hot water, tell us and we will go back to the landlord straight away. You also mentioned a faulty letterbox on 13 May. We will log it as a separate request. Please send a short description of the fault and any photo. Kind regards, Maya Chen, Northbridge Lettings
unknowns: Whether hot water and boiler power are restored
Whether the plumber really attended on 14 May and what was done
Invoice/cost position for the landlord's own plumber
